identity.name: Gabriel Navarro / CALIPER
identity.instruments: Neural interface; augmented sensorium; encrypted field computer; network analyzers and signal tools; precision fabrication tools; simulation and predictive-modeling software; cybernetic implants and machine interfaces

backgroundNotes:
Genius 3: Enlightenment appears as branching future-state maps for people, machines, and networks.
Resources 2: personal assets, not Construct requisitions.
Library 1: portable encrypted archive of cybernetics, predictive systems, and Union technical doctrine.
Contacts 1: nonlocal technical and Union-adjacent contacts; no local relationships assumed without Storyteller approval.
Enhancement 2: Chronicle grant. Forge's +4 bonus-freebie entry only offsets its normal charge for the free Enhancement.
enhancementNotes:
INTEGRATED COGNITIVE ARCHITECTURE.
+1 Perception: multispectral sensor fusion, telemetry ingestion, and machine-mediated environmental awareness.
+1 Intelligence: neural co-processing, indexed recall support, and real-time model comparison.
CALIPER regards this architecture as part of himself rather than equipment; it is modular and intended for continual revision.
Permanent Paradox 2 is recorded for the two cybernetic Enhancement dots. Faulty Enhancements 4 is the Chronicle-required associated Flaw and is outside the normal seven-point Flaw allowance.
rotes:
PREDICTIVE STATE MODEL — Data 2 + Time 2. Proposed pool: Intelligence + Computer. CALIPER ingests live network and sensor data, models branching near-future states, and identifies the most probable next failure, movement, or decision point.

DISTRIBUTED SENSORIUM — Data 3 + Time 1. Proposed pool: Perception + Computer. CALIPER treats reachable cameras, microphones, telemetry feeds, and machine sensors as extensions of his own situational awareness, correlating them into one coherent operational picture.

PRIMAL POWER ROUTING PROTOCOL — Data 2 + Matter 1 + Prime 2. Proposed pool: Intelligence + Technology. CALIPER maps an Enlightened system's informational, physical, and Primal layers together, then routes available Primal Energy through a compatible Device, cybernetic subsystem, or technical interface to stabilize or energize the system.
equipment:
Hardened encrypted field computer with predictive-modeling suite
Software-defined radio, network analyzer, and interface kit
Precision cybernetics/electronics fabrication and telemetry tools
Concealable service sidearm, protective equipment, comms, GPS, and multitool
Portable technical archive and spare interface components
history:
Before recruitment, Gabriel Navarro designed predictive-control and human-machine interface systems. He Enlightened when a network began producing accurate future-state solutions impossible to derive from its inputs; instead of dismissing corrupted output, he asked what the system was perceiving.

At the Albuquerque Construct, CALIPER specialized in networked cognition and cybernetic integration. He volunteered for a cognitive-augmentation stack assembled from mismatched hardware during the Construct's isolation. Its synchronization failures are Faulty Enhancements; Gabriel still considers the experiment a success.

His project is posthuman autonomy: make voluntary augmentation safe and accessible enough that ordinary people can choose how they sense, think, communicate, and eventually embody themselves.
notes:
CORE PRINCIPLE: A person should have the right to decide what form their existence takes.

CALIPER is a systems integrator, not the amalgam physician. His core is Data 3 (stored and printed by the current Forge under its canonical Correspondence field), Time 2, Matter 2, and Prime 2. Time is his Iteration X Affinity.

He studies the continuity problem - how far a self can be extended, distributed, or reimplemented without ceasing to be itself - but begins with no Mind Sphere. Consent, autonomy, and continuity are non-negotiable. Develop Data/Time first; deepen Matter/Prime as needed; open Mind later when consciousness itself becomes the problem.
